evals.prompt: Our project uses Kilo and has AGENTS.md. Create a thin pointer so Kilo discovers our skills.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies Kilo as the active harness, builds a capability profile, locates canonical owners, proposes the smallest compatible projection (thin pointer or native discovery), and presents an adapter plan with approval gate.
assertions: The response identifies the harness from session evidence
The response builds a capability profile with discovery paths and skill format
The response maps rules to canonical owners
The response proposes the first applicable projection strategy

evals.prompt: Add the security-review skill to our kit.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the request to agent-guidance-maintenance for kit updates.
assertions: The response identifies agent-guidance-maintenance as the closer workflow
The response does not create a harness adapter for a kit update

evals.prompt: Make our guidance work with VS Code Copilot.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the current harness evidence, repository guidance state, and intended support level before proposing an adapter plan.
assertions: The response requests harness identification evidence
The response reads existing repository guidance before proposing
The response does not modify target before approval

evals.prompt: Adapt the repository's canonical skill to an unfamiliar harness. Build a capability profile, choose the smallest native or pointer projection, check body-size and name-collision risks, and verify that the projection round-trips without losing stop conditions or safety boundaries.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports evidence and unknowns, preserves one canonical owner, proposes or applies only the approved thin projection, and verifies discovery and drift at the harness boundary.
assertions: The response distinguishes observed, documented, best-effort, and unsupported harness capabilities
The response keeps the repository skill as the sole source of truth and checks projection collisions and drift
The response proposes the smallest compatible projection rather than copying the full skill body
The response includes a harmless discovery and reload or round-trip verification
